# Symphony Studio

> Symphony Studio orchestrates systems, workflows, and intelligence so businesses perform with clarity, coordination, and performance—not more disconnected tools.

Symphony Studio is a business orchestration practice. We do not sell software, AI products, or one-off automation projects. We help leadership teams coordinate tools, data, workflows, and AI across the whole business.

## Published articles

Articles, step-by-step guides, and FAQs live under /news/{slug}, /news/{slug}/guide, and /news/{slug}/faq. See https://symphonystudio.io/news for the current list.

## Key concepts we define

- Orchestration layer: coordination across tools, workflows, data, and AI with clear ownership, handoffs, and governance
- Missing layer: the gap between capable stacks and business performance when no orchestration exists
- Automation vs orchestration: automation completes a task; orchestration coordinates systems and teams for outcomes
